messages:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — Acme wants a 6mo dedicated commit for a POC. Asking for 100 GPU-hours/month equivalent reserved, + 3x burst for first 2 months. Asking for 30% off our commit rate. Need deal-desk approval, customer wants answer today.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Couple quick q's — what model / avg seq len? burst profile (spiky vs sustained)? that changes cost math a lot.
Sam (AE): They'll run assistant + reranker. avg seq ~512 tokens; spikes to ~4k tokens on some evals. Traffic: baseline low, big spikes during demo windows. Customer ok w/ pre-warm if needed.
Gabe (Sales Ops): 30% off is above standard authorizations. We can consider a structured concession: smaller % discount + constrained burst SLAs. Can you share target ARR or expected monthly committed $?
Sam (AE): Expected ARR if they convert ~$180k/yr. For POC they want 6mo commit first, then scale.
Ivy (Finance): Need monthly committed $ to approve concession. Also need to see true GPU-hour calc. If list = $0.25 / GPU-hour, rough calc:

```
monthly_hours = 100
list_cost = monthly_hours * 0.25 = $25
6mo_commit = 25 * 6 = $150
30% off => commit_price = 150 * 0.7 = $105
```

This is tiny — double-check units. Are we talking 100 GPU-hours/month or 100 GPUs reserved? big diff.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Thanks — Sam it's 100 GPU-hours/month (not GPUs). So Ivy calc stands but remember burst multiplies usage for short windows. If they use 3x burst for 2 months that could add ~200-400 extra hours in practice.
Luca (SRE): Operational note — supporting 3x burst requires pre-warmed pool or burst quota. We can grant up to 2x burst without infra changes; >2x needs a carveout (engineering + capacity lead time). Also region matters for scheduling.
Gabe (Sales Ops): Proposal from ops/sales side: approve 20% discount on the 6mo commit + burst policy: 2x burst allowed immediately, 3x burst for first 30 days only and capped at 500 extra hours; additional 3x requests require 72h notice and ops signoff. This keeps risk bounded.
Sam (AE): Customer will accept that if we give small extra runway first month. Can we do 22% instead of 20 and 3x for first 30 days? they asked specifically for 30% but said they'd take a bit less.
Ivy (Finance): We can flex to 22% with manager signoff. Need legal to add burst cap in the SOW and a clause for excess usage billing at standard on-demand rates. Also require customer to pre-announce scheduled demos for >2x burst.
Gabe (Sales Ops): I'll draft the SOW language and open a deal-desk ticket. Salesbot creating ticket...
salesbot: Created ticket DECK-4897 — "Acme POC commit: 6mo, 100 GPU-hrs/mo, 22% discount, burst policy" <https://redwood.atlassian.example/DECK-4897>
Luca (SRE): One more: for the 3x initial burst we'll need to reserve a warm pool in us-west-2. Ops charge for warm pool is ~$0.05 / GPU-hour. Add that to the cost appendix.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll put a small runbook in the SOW describing the burst activation flow and the 72h notice requirement.
Sam (AE): OK pushing to customer: 22% discount, 2x burst allowed immediately, 3x only in first 30 days capped at 500 extra hours, 72h notice for further bursts. Expect acceptance — pls expedite SOW + deal desk approval. :crossed_fingers:
Gabe (Sales Ops): I'll escalate to manager for formal signoff. tagging @Ivy for final headcount approval. :thumbsup:
Ivy (Finance): I can sign off on 22% with the SOW clauses and the warm-pool fee added. Approving contingent on SOW link in ticket.
Sam (AE): Thanks all — will update thread once customer signs.
